title: Fun and convivial! Highly recommended
text: A really, really recommended experience! It was super fun and we also ate very well and to our fill😋 fantastic welcome with an aperitif and appetizers, then various dishes are prepared together; the nice thing is that no one is “obligated” to cook like in a real course, the atmosphere is more convivial and spontaneous. Excellent value for money, very accessible. Go there!!!
author: 09199CH

title: Fantastic
text:
A fantastic and fun day!! A pleasant day and you learn cool cooking tricks
The truth is that I was surprised by what I managed to learn

Esteve is a star!
author: jaumef985

title: Very nice experience
text: Great activity, we really had a very good time! We learned how to prepare a paella and several Spanish tapas (tortilla, toast...), in a super nice and friendly atmosphere. There were 8 of us. It was really nice to be able to cook ourselves, discover the recipes, and then enjoy everything together. We laughed a lot and, above all, ate very well, all while sharing some good Spanish wine (or soft drinks) 😋 An activity that I really recommend, whether with friends, as a couple, or in a group. It was a great immersive experience in Catalan culture and I would do it again without hesitation!
author: vandermolena

title: Highly recommended experience!
text: Highly recommended! We had a wonderful time. I went as a couple and shared the experience with people I didn't know. We learned to cook paella, tapas, and potato omelet. The atmosphere was very pleasant, as well as fun, thanks to Esteve, the chef, who is charming. He was attentive the whole time to explain tricks and answer questions. Ideal for learning about local cuisine in a relaxed and laid-back environment.  Definitely worth repeating!
author: marimargreen

title: Very good experience
text: It is a very good activity to do something different in Barcelona. And Esteve - the chef - is didactic with the recipes, has a lot of patience, and makes the experience dynamic and fun.
author: V3103YYcarlat

title: Perfect culinary experience of typical Catalan tapas
text:
It has been an incredible workshop in which we have enjoyed ourselves a lot, first for what you learn and what you cook, and then for the relationship you establish with the people who share that moment. Esteve recreates a very familiar and close atmosphere that makes the experience very rewarding. You learn to make typical Catalan tapas, and above all the star dish which is paella. Delicious!!! 
100% recommended.
